title: Designing green-emissive Cu,N-codoped carbon dots by pyrolysis of aromatic precursors and application in sensing of Fe(III) and Cr(VI)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22698-22712
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00625F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thien-Phuc Nguyen, Nhu Vo Thi Thu, Minh Hao Hoang, Nham Linh Nguyen, Thanh-Sang Nguyen, Dat Nguyen, Nhiem Ly, Thanh Tuyen Nguyen, Phuong V. Pham, Dinh Khoi Dang
Solvent-free pyrolysis of aromatic precursors yields green-emissive Cu,N-co-doped carbon dots for simultaneous Fe(III) and Cr(VI) detection, achieving a record-low Cr(VI) LOD of 19.6 nM.
